lines.zh: 我四条腿走，第九条不知道往哪放。
lines.en: Four legs walk. The ninth doesn't know where to go.
I have two tails now.

lines.zh: 有一条在动，我没让它动。
lines.en: One of them moves. I didn't tell it to.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边掉下东西。
lines.en: I shed things as I walk.
I follow the fence, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 我的毛一块一块，颜色不对。
lines.en: My fur comes in patches. Wrong colors.
I pass by the henhouse.
That smell reminds me of something.
I drop low, then stand again.
My legs don't all point the same way.

lines.zh: 我走过雪地，脚印是乱的。
lines.en: I cross snow and my tracks are a mess.
I head toward the crowing in the village.
I leap once. It carries me far.

lines.zh: 落地的时候，多了一条腿撑着。
lines.en: On landing, an extra leg takes my weight.
I shake myself and can't shake it off.

lines.zh: 有一条尾巴在动，我没让它动。
lines.en: One of my tails moves, and I did not move it.
I lie in the grass and my tail moves.
I'm listening. I have three ears.
Each one hears something different.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，味道不对。
lines.en: I lick a forepaw. The taste is wrong.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，嘴张得太开。
lines.en: I yawn, and my mouth opens too wide.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上不是狐狸的形状。
lines.en: My shadow isn't shaped like a fox.

lines.zh: 有只兔子在远处，我没动。
lines.en: A rabbit is far off. I don't move.
I used to chase those.
Now I only want to watch.
The things on me are shifting places.

lines.zh: 我低头咬了一口，咬到自己。
lines.en: I bite down and catch myself.
In the end I let go.
I lower myself down.
The grass hides me.
The grass covers me, and that is fine.
I don't much want to be seen.
Stand still. Don't come closer.

lines.zh: 我不太确定我会做什么。
lines.en: I'm not sure what I'll do.
I remember people give food.
I remember hands being warm.
My paws don't much look like paws now.
Don't crouch down.
If you crouch I'll want to come close.
And then it's hard to say.
I tilt my head and study you a long while.
Your smell is very clean.
Mine isn't.
Step back and I will too.

lines.zh: 我的皮肉翻开，自己合上。
lines.en: My flesh opens, then closes on its own.
It grew back the wrong shape.
I cry out with what sounds like two throats.
I drag my leg back into the grass.
My legs are tangling.
I sort them out for a long while.
The blood is black and slow.
It doesn't really hurt.
The thing inside hurts.
We both hurt.
That smell. I know it.
Meat? Or something else?
I reach a foreleg forward.
Wrong number of legs. I walk crooked.
Set it down. Don't hand it to me.
Don't move when I come close.
This smell splits into two in my nose.
This smell, I can't place it.
One bite, and I taste iron.

lines.zh: 味道在嘴里变成了别的。
lines.en: The taste changes in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里那团东西动了。
lines.en: Something in my throat moves.
I didn't mean it.
And I'm still hungry.
I just don't want this.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴上，长出第二层皮。
lines.en: A second skin grows over my tail.
Put it away; my teeth feel wrong.
You bump me and I come apart a little.
And gather again.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖擦过你，留下麻。
lines.en: My tail tip brushes you and leaves numbness.
That'll be numb a while.
I leap away and land far off.
An extra leg appears on landing.
All three of my ears turn to you.
You haven't moved a step.
Then I'll leap again.
Further this time.

lines.zh: 我记得狐狸是怎么叫的。
lines.en: I remember how foxes call.
I tried. The sound was wrong.
A real fox came by once.
It looked at me once and left.
It knew the smell on me.
I didn't follow.
There'd be no point.
I know what I am.
So I keep to myself.
That's livable.
I pick it up and run two steps.
Only running do I notice the extra legs.
I trip and drop it.
I pick it up again.
This time I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它埋在土里，同化的爪子挖得快。
lines.en: I bury it in the soil; assimilated claws dig fast.
Afterward I forget where.

lines.zh: 被同化的狐狸，尾巴还是蓬的.
lines.en: An assimilated fox still has a bushy tail.
I've covered the smell with my own.
I sit down and stop looking.
Noise from the henhouse.
I press my body down as low as it goes.
Something in me is excited.
The smell of chickens pulls at me.
I crawl that way.
My tails wag as I crawl.
All three of them.
I stop under the fence.
Wings inside.
I look up and see a gap.
I follow the sound.
It's on the other side of the fence.
I walk around the fence.

lines.zh: 走了半圈，我忘了在追什么。
lines.en: Half a circuit and I forget what I'm after.
My legs won't go on.
There's a smell on the wind.
I veer toward the fence.
There's the sound again.

lines.zh: 我现在有两条尾巴，一条自己在动。
lines.en: I have two tails now, and one moves on its own.
Back and forth like this several times.
I spring and bite.
My teeth are wrong. The bite is shallow.
This fox has been assimilated.
I pounce again from another angle.
This time the legs arrive first.
The two of us roll together.
It struggles beneath me.
I get off it.
It runs off into the wood.
I sit where I am.

lines.zh: 我从一片黑草里站起来。
lines.en: I get up out of a patch of black grass.
Four legs. Then more.
I try walking. It works, roughly.
I know this village.
I used to live near here.
Back then I had four legs.
I look that way.
The henhouse is still standing.
The door is new.
I don't plan to go in.
Fire catches my fur and I roll in the mud.

lines.zh: 我从高处跳下来，落地摔散了。
lines.en: I jump from height and break apart on landing.

lines.zh: 水进了肺里，我挣不上来。
lines.en: Water in my lungs and I can't get up.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，尾巴断了两条。
lines.en: The blast flips me and two tails snap off.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我，被慢慢挤出来。
lines.en: An arrow goes in and is slowly pushed out.

lines.zh: 一道光烧掉了我身上的一部分。
lines.en: A light burns away part of what's on me.
I'm hungry and can't eat.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我看见了两个自己。
lines.en: Lightning falls and I see two of me.

lines.zh: 我一直往下，腿在空里划。
lines.en: I fall and my legs row at nothing.
